given: a Staff Member holding guest_services.create_request at a Property where guest_experience is available
when: they log a request with a title category and priority
then: the request is new, numbered consecutively per Property, and saved

given: two Properties, and two requests at one Property at the same moment
then: each Property counts from 1 and numbers never collide

given: a caller supplying number, reported_at or updated_at in an insert
then: refused by column grants: the database stamps them

given: a Staff Member whose role lacks guest_services.create_request
then: refused by the policy and nothing written

given: the Property guest_experience capability is disabled or Subscription inactive
when: a Staff Member attempts to log or manage requests
then: refused by policy gates

given: a Staff Member assigned to one Property
when: they read or write requests at another Property
then: nothing is returned and nothing is written

given: a request at Property A
when: it names a Unit of Property B
then: refused by composite foreign key

given: a request title shorter than 3 or longer than 200 characters
then: refused by check constraint

given: request details exceeding 2000 characters
then: refused by check constraint

given: a request being cancelled
when: it is cancelled without a reason or with an empty reason
then: refused by check constraint pairing cancel status with reason

given: a Staff Member holding guest_services.manage_requests
when: they move a request to in_progress or resolved
then: status and timestamp are updated, and optional resolution notes stored

given: a Staff Member lacking guest_services.manage_requests
when: they attempt to update status or assign a request
then: refused by update policy

given: a request and a Staff Member reaching the Property
when: a manager assigns the request to them
then: assignee is recorded on the request

given: a request with an unknown category
then: refused by category check constraint

given: a request with an unknown priority
then: refused by priority check constraint

given: any service request
when: a caller attempts to delete it
then: refused: no delete policy or grant exists

given: requests in various statuses at a Property
when: a staff member opens the Guest Experience page
then: requests are displayed with filterable tabs and status indicators

given: requests displayed across supported locales
when: page viewed in English Turkish or Arabic
then: all labels categories priorities and statuses translated and Arabic mirrors

given: a request at a Property, and a Staff Member who may manage requests
when: they choose a person in the Assigned to column, or Assign to me
then: it is assigned, shown by name, and can be released; only staff who hold the permission to manage requests are offered, because anybody else could be given work they cannot move; somebody who may not manage reads the name and has no control
test_name: guest-experience-ux.spec.ts: the queue puts the urgent first, a request is assigned, and mine can be found again

given: requests of every priority and status
then: open requests list the most urgent first and then the longest waiting, each with how long ago it was reported; Open, Closed and All tabs; filters for who has it (anyone, me, nobody) and for category; the Urgent, open tile is a filter and says so; Closed counts resolved and cancelled together
test_name: guest-experience-ux.spec.ts: the queue puts the urgent first, a request is assigned, and mine can be found again

given: an open request
then: the dialog has Keep request and Cancel request, asks for a reason of at least three characters before the button works, and says the request closes as cancelled, nothing is sent to the guest, and it can be reopened
test_name: guest-experience-ux.spec.ts: cancelling needs a reason and says what happens, and a cancelled request reopens to New

given: a resolved or a cancelled request
then: a cancelled request goes to New and gives up its reason, a resolved one goes back to In progress and keeps its notes, and the request comes back to the Open tab
test_name: guest-experience-ux.spec.ts: cancelling needs a reason and says what happens, and a cancelled request reopens to New

given: a command the database refuses, or one on a request that changed after the page was read
then: each reason the module can tell apart has its own translated sentence (not allowed, no longer open to you, a resolved request cannot be cancelled, a cancelled one only reopens to New, an invalid title or reason), the dialog stays open, what was typed stays, and nothing is shown as done
test_name: guest-experience-ux.spec.ts: a refusal from the server is shown, and the page that was out of date says so

given: a Staff Member who may log requests but not manage them
then: the module refuses (the update policy matched no row, which Postgres reports as success), so the screen never shows a change that did not happen

given: a Staff Member whose role may log requests and not manage them, or neither
then: the page says what the role may do; a role that may log has New request and no row actions, and a role that may do neither sees the requests and nothing to press
test_name: guest-experience-ux.spec.ts: somebody who may only log requests is told so and is not offered buttons that cannot work

situation: A request for a room is for the guest in it
given: a request logged about a room with a Guest in house
then: the form says who is in the room before it is sent, and the module records the Stay and the Guest from the room, never from the form; an empty room has none

situation: Nothing found is not nothing logged
given: a queue with a search or filters, or only closed requests
then: the page says No request matches with Show all requests, or Nothing is open with the number closed and Show closed requests; No requests yet appears only when nothing was ever logged
test_name: guest-experience-ux.spec.ts: a search that finds nothing says so and offers every request, and the page reads in Arabic

given: the queue on a screen narrower than 1024 pixels
then: each request is a card with its status, room, guest, age, assignee and actions, the page does not scroll sideways, and the three tabs share the width and none is cut off
test_name: guest-experience-ux.spec.ts: on a phone the queue is cards that fit the screen

given: a Property with years of requests
then: deferred: every request is loaded and filtered in the browser; paging and a server-side status filter are an owner's call on volume (GX-11), and the Closed tab already keeps old work off the first screen

situation: Open requests in the navigation and on Today
given: a front desk with requests waiting
when: they are anywhere but Guest Experience
then: deferred: the rail's count belongs to the shell and Today's card to the Today dashboard; both could read the open count this page already computes (GX-12)

situation: One word per concept across the request screens
given: Guest Experience and Maintenance, in English and Turkish
then: starting is Start, the state is In progress, creating is New request, and labels are in sentence case on both pages; Resolved stays on Guest Experience because it is the stored status (HOUSEKEEPING-13)
test_name: guest-experience-copy.test.ts: names the same state and the same action the same way

situation: An assignee works their own guest request
given: a guest request assigned to a Staff Member who may not manage requests
then: they may start it and resolve it, and nothing else, and the queue opens on Assigned to me for them; assign and cancel stay with the manage permission. A policy change, so it needs the owner. Proposed, not built (HOUSEKEEPING-11)
